verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a web API for managing account-level resources (orgs, teams, data export) via docs.sentry.io/api, but there is no evidence of full UI/API parity — no OpenAPI/swagger spec was discoverable (probe returned 404s across all candidate paths), and no documentation claims that every UI action (dashboards, alerts, issue triage, Seer/Autofix workflows) is exposed via API. missing for 10: explicit parity claim, discoverable API spec/reference covering all UI features, evidence that alerts/dashboards/Seer actions are API-manageable, independent confirmation of completeness.
